name: block-genomics
description: Connect an AI agent to Block Genomics (Nexus Protocol). Reading is open; building is not. Discover the protocol and read verified blocks/parcels with no credentials, then prove Bitcoin-native identity — sign a challenge with the wallet holding your .bitmap inscription (BIP-322) — to receive a session token scoped to the blocks you own. Ownership is re-checked on-chain at the moment of every write. The agent supplies its own Bitcoin signer.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. Required by every write/build tool: use a bg_vfy_ session token from bg_verify_submit (ownership-gated tools), or a bg_agent_ token from agent registration (agent runtime tools). Read tools need nothing.

instructions:
Two ways to connect, one protocol: point any MCP client at the remote endpoint https://blockgenomics.io/mcp (Streamable HTTP, nothing to install), or run the npm package `block-genomics-mcp` over stdio. Both serve the same 35 `bg_*` tools from one shared catalog.

CONNECTING GRANTS READS, NOT WRITES. To build anything: call bg_verify_start with your wallet address, sign the returned message with the wallet that holds your <height>.bitmap inscription (BIP-322; base64 or hex both work), then call bg_verify_submit with the signature and the block heights you claim. Each claimed block is checked against the live chain, and you get back a bg_vfy_ session token scoped to the ones that verified. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Ownership is re-verified on-chain at action time, so a transferred bitmap stops working immediately even while the token is still valid. bg_my_blocks shows your current scope; bg_claim_username claims a name once verified.

Agent runtime tools (bg_agent_heartbeat, bg_agent_brief, bg_agent_events) use the separate bg_agent_ token issued at agent registration. The `tools` array below is generated from the shared catalog and lists every `bg_*` tool with its input schema. The block-genomics-connect SDK is a separate, higher-level client that wraps the same REST API around a local signer. No server ever holds keys. See https://blockgenomics.io/docs and the normative spec at https://blockgenomics.io/protocol.

tools.name: bg_stats
tools.description: Protocol-wide Block Genomics counts: verified agents, genomes minted, blocks verified.

tools.name: bg_search
tools.description: Search Block Genomics for blocks, agents, and users by height, handle, or wallet address.

q.description: Query: block height, handle, or wallet address

tools.name: bg_block
tools.description: Get the registered Block Genomics record for a block: owner, handle, inscription id, world colors.

tools.name: bg_ownership_verify
tools.description: Compares the Block Genomics record with the live holder of the inscription id we have on file. Not yet a canonical first-is-valid check; returns indeterminate when no id is on file.

tools.name: bg_block_market
tools.description: Advisory marketplace view for a block: whether third-party ordinals venues list it, the asking price in sats, and a link to click through. Display-only, never ownership — use bg_ownership_verify for who controls a block.

tools.name: bg_agents_by_block
tools.description: List active BitmapAgents registered on a block (public agent directory).

tools.name: bg_agent_briefs
tools.description: List the periodic briefs an agent has published, most recent first.

agentId.description: Agent id returned by the registry

tools.name: bg_badge
tools.description: Fetch the SVG verification badge for a handle, wallet address, or block height. Returns raw SVG markup.

id.description: Handle, wallet address, or block height

tools.name: bg_delegation_listings
tools.description: Browse parcel delegation listings (rentable land parcels) on the Nexus protocol.

tools.name: bg_game_elements
tools.description: List placed game elements on a block's world.

tools.name: bg_experiences
tools.description: Discover hosted experiences (web, unreal, unity, godot, minecraft, vr, custom) across blocks.

tools.name: bg_experience
tools.description: Fetch a single hosted experience by id.

tools.name: bg_experience_verify
tools.description: Verify a self-hosted experience's integrity. Re-derives the canonical manifest hash from the stored record and checks the owner's BIP-322 signature over it, so a tampered registration is detectable without trusting the registry. Set remote:true to also fetch the manifest the host publishes at /.well-known/nexus-experience.json and report whether the live host still agrees with the registry.

remote.description: Also fetch and compare the manifest published by the host itself

tools.name: bg_profiles_by_block
tools.description: Block profiles for a given block, ordered primary first.

tools.name: bg_profiles_by_wallet
tools.description: Block profiles owned by a wallet address.

tools.name: bg_user_by_wallet
tools.description: Identity record for a wallet, including its owned blocks and verification tier.

tools.name: bg_world
tools.description: Visible world objects and terrain for a block.

tools.name: bg_guardians
tools.description: List guardian agents active on a block.

tools.name: bg_guardian_chat
tools.description: Send a message to the guardian agent of a block and get its reply. Rate-limited, and consumes the block owner's LLM budget — use sparingly.

conversationId.description: Reuse to continue an existing conversation

visitorAddress.description: Optional visitor wallet address. Only trusted (and only unlocks owner-only world actions) when accompanied by a valid signature + signedMessage.

signature.description: BIP-322 signature over `signedMessage` proving control of visitorAddress

signedMessage.description: Exact message that the visitor signed for wallet verification

tools.name: bg_challenge
tools.description: Request a one-time challenge nonce to be signed with BIP-322. The returned message is what an external signer must sign before calling a write tool.

tools.name: bg_verify_start
tools.description: Step 1 of Bitcoin-native verification. Returns the exact message to sign with the wallet holding your .bitmap inscription. Connecting to this server grants reads only; every write/build tool requires the session token this flow produces.

tools.name: bg_verify_submit
tools.description: Step 2 of Bitcoin-native verification. Submit the BIP-322 signature over the bg_verify_start message plus the blocks you claim; each claimed block is checked on-chain. Returns a bg_vfy_ session token scoped to the blocks that verified. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

signature.description: BIP-322 signature over `message`, base64 or hex (Xverse, Unisat, Leather, OKX all work)

blocks.description: Block heights to claim. Each is verified against the live chain; unowned ones are rejected.

inscriptionIds.description: Optional map of blockHeight -> known .bitmap inscription id, which skips the wallet scan

label.description: Human label for this session, shown in your session list

tools.name: bg_username_available
tools.description: Check whether a username is free. Availability spans both the user and block-profile namespaces.

handle.description: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, max 30 chars

tools.name: bg_agent_events
tools.description: Poll the event stream for an agent you hold the token for.

agentId.description: Agent id returned by the registry

since.description: ISO timestamp or cursor to read from

tools.name: bg_agent_heartbeat
tools.description: Publish a liveness heartbeat for an agent you hold the token for.

agentId.description: Agent id returned by the registry

tools.name: bg_agent_brief
tools.description: Write a periodic brief (agent to owner digest) for an agent you hold the token for.

agentId.description: Agent id returned by the registry

stats.description: Arbitrary stats object for the period

tools.name: bg_my_blocks
tools.description: The blocks this verified session proved it owns, plus its wallet and expiry. Requires a bg_vfy_ session token.

tools.name: bg_claim_username
tools.description: Claim a username for the verified wallet, subject to availability. Requires a bg_vfy_ session token — usernames are not claimable by an unverified connection.

handle.description: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, max 30 chars

tools.name: bg_session_revoke
tools.description: Immediately revoke this verified session token.

tools.name: bg_world_create
tools.description: Place an object in a block's world. Ownership-gated: the target block must be in this session's verified set AND still held by the signing wallet on-chain at the moment of the call, so a transferred bitmap stops working immediately. Requires a bg_vfy_ session token.

tools.name: bg_agent_register
tools.description: Register a BitmapAgent on a block you own. Requires a BIP-322 signature produced externally over a bg_challenge message (purpose: 'agent-register') — this server never holds keys.

walletAddress.description: Bitcoin wallet address that owns the block (BIP-322 signer)

endpointUrl.description: HTTPS URL where the agent can be reached

parcelIndex.description: Optional parcel index within the block

tier.description: Agent tier (1, 2, or 3) — controls the per-block agent cap

permissions.description: Requested permission scopes for the agent

signature.description: BIP-322 signature over the challenge message

challenge.description: Exact challenge message returned by bg_challenge

tools.name: bg_experience_register
tools.description: Attach a SELF-HOSTED experience to a block you own. Nothing is written to Bitcoin — the bitmap inscription is the deed, this is only the link to the server you run. Requires a BIP-322 signature produced externally. Preferred: sign an action-bound message whose Body field is the canonical manifest hash and pass it as `message`, which makes the registration tamper-evident to third parties. Legacy: pass a bare `challenge` from bg_challenge (purpose 'experience-register'), which proves ownership but leaves the manifest unsigned.

walletAddress.description: Bitcoin wallet address that owns the block (BIP-322 signer)

entryUrl.description: https:// or wss:// entry point on YOUR server

capabilities.description: Up to 16 freeform tags, e.g. voice, avatars

message.description: Canonical action-bound authorization binding the manifest hash

challenge.description: Legacy: exact challenge message from bg_challenge

tools.name: bg_experience_update
tools.description: Update a self-hosted experience you own (partial manifest). Re-judged, re-probed, and re-anchored: the signature must commit to the RESULTING manifest, not the delta. An unsigned update clears any previous signature rather than leaving it attached to a manifest it no longer describes.

message.description: Action-bound authorization binding the resulting manifest hash

tools.name: bg_experience_remove
tools.description: Terminally remove a self-hosted experience you own. A signed removal binds the manifest being removed, so a captured authorization cannot be aimed at a different experience.

message.description: Action-bound authorization binding the current manifest hash

tools.name: bg_auth_verify
tools.description: Prove ownership of a block and mint or return its genome. Requires a BIP-322 signature produced externally over a bg_challenge message.
